whenToUse: Fields that must be retyped when wrong, such as passwords or verification codes.
Errors must be reported right after submitting.
The error is close to where people are looking.
whenNotToUse: Reporting errors in several fields at once (use an error summary).
Checking in real time while typing (use inline validation).
There's only a shake and no error message.

alternatives.name: Inline Validation
alternatives.reason: Showing errors on each field right away.

alternatives.name: Error Summary
alternatives.reason: Gathering several errors in one place.

accessibility: Connect the error message to the field with aria-invalid and aria-describedby.
The error message has role=status, so screen readers hear it too.
With reduced motion, it doesn't shake; only the color and message change.
The error is stated in words, not only color, so people who can't tell colors apart still know.
